annotations.title: Find a song’s key and tempo

description: Find the musical key (major or minor, with its relative key) and the tempo in BPM of a song file the person has. Opens a small Tera Studio tool where they choose the file; it is analysed in their browser and never uploaded. Use it when someone asks what key or BPM a song is in, or wants to know before singing, mixing or practising it. It reads only the file and doesn't identify or play songs; find_song_key looks up a well-known song by its title.
name: find_song_key_and_tempo
title: Find a song’s key and tempo
